hooks.name: privacy-guard-on-save
hooks.description: On every saved Swift file, enforce privacy.md and the layering tables: network only in Services/Sync or Services/Notification, no analytics SDKs, no secrets, no SMS-provider credentials anywhere, honest copy (no collision prevention/prediction claims, no 'emergency services notified' or 'help is on the way', footage is never called 'evidence' and capture is never claimed assured), Models/Metrics and the Packages/WhooshWire package import Foundation only (no AVFoundation/CoreMedia/CoreVideo/Photos/CoreMotion/HealthKit/WatchKit/WatchConnectivity), Views never import CoreLocation/SwiftData, capture/asset-writer APIs only in Services/Camera (detectors consume frames), Photos export only in Services/Camera/PhotosClipExporter.swift, WatchConnectivity only in Whoosh/Services/Remote/WCSessionWireLink.swift and WhooshWatch/Services/Link/, HealthKit/HKWorkoutSession only in WhooshWatch/Services/Workout/ and Whoosh/Services/Remote/WatchLauncher.swift, WatchKit haptics (WKInterfaceDevice/WKHapticType) only in WhooshWatch/Services/Haptics/, WhooshWatch/ imports no CoreLocation/MapKit/AVFoundation/CoreMedia/CoreVideo/Photos or networking API, the network layers never reference camera/clip/footage or wire types, screen brightness/idle-timer only in Services/Screen (ActiveRideView until task 21), tel:/telprompt: only in Features/Emergency, MessageUI only in Support/Representables, CoreMotion only in Services/Crash or Services/Camera, Keychain SecItem only in Services/Contacts, AVAudioSession only in Services/Alerts. The script also scans WhooshWatch/ and Packages/WhooshWire/Sources/ when run with no arguments.
